about.subtitle: Talk To Paste — v{{version}}
about.description: Thanks for using TTP! This is a free, open-source app I built to make voice-to-text effortless. Just press your hotkey, speak, and your words are transcribed and pasted instantly — powered by Groq's fast AI, with smart polish to clean up filler words and grammar. TTP also learns from your corrections over time.
about.author: Built by Amir KELLOU--SIDHOUM. If you find it useful, feel free to share it or connect with me!
about.privacyBody: TTP collects absolutely none of your data. Your API key is stored locally on your machine only. Audio is sent directly from your device to Groq's servers for transcription — I never see, store, or have access to any of it. Same for AI Polish: your text goes straight to Groq, not through me. Everything stays between you and your API provider.
